title: vinca humilis
intro: Vinca humilis, commonly known as the small periwinkle or dwarf periwinkle, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of wounds, inflammation, and infections, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Vinca humilis include wound healing, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, making it a potential source for the development of new pharmaceuticals.
